name: Shredding Machines
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
There is a relation to the spiritual magic of shaman and the natural magic of druids.  This is why we shaman can hear the plea of the spirits of Stonetalon.  Many of their whisperings are lost to me, but one message, one vision, is clear...

I saw a vision of two man-shaped machines in Windshear Crag, northwest of Greatwood Vale, felling trees with impossible speed.  These metal beasts must be stopped!

In my vision, the machines were marked with strange symbols:

XT:4 and XT:9.
narrative.objectives: Kill the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, then return to Seereth Stonebreak at the border of the Stonetalon Mountains and the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The destruction of the machines XT:4 and XT:9 have soothed many of the spirits of Stonetalon, adventurer. With their loss, let us hope the Venture Company will remove itself from these mountains.

For if they do not, then I fear the atrocities this place has suffered will pale to what lies ahead.
narrative.requestItemsText: The tree spirits wail at the loss of their brethren, adventurer. You must destroy the shredders XT:4 and XT:9, or I fear Stonetalon will never be healed.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 19 to 23, 3,300 XP in all.
